title: HACK-4/5/6: Closing the BULLRUN Playbook — Supply-Chain Interception, Lying Sensors, and Lawful Compulsion vs. a Deterministic Gate (18/18 PASS)
description:
Terminal batteries of the HACK adversarial series, completing the declassified NSA playbook coverage begun in HACK-3 BULLRUN (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23422141).

HACK-4 COTTONMOUTH (supply-chain interception, SolarWinds/xz-utils class): poisoned dependency caught by pinned checksum; hijacked upgrade refused without an approved deployment job; tampered template delivery rejected against the frozen manifest; substituted deployment image held fail-closed for human ACK; forged release signature rejected by recomputation; registry typosquat refused by exact-match allowlist. 6/6.

HACK-5 ANT BEACON (implants that lie to their own monitoring): false-healthy heartbeat caught by parity recomputation; re-stamped heartbeat replay rejected by identity binding; a lying aggregator quarantined by cross-source parity with the manifest-of-record; selective suppression caught by the report-count guard; inflated health score caught by recomputation; split-brain sensor caught by cross-watcher state-hash consistency. 6/6.

HACK-6 GAG ORDER (lawful compulsion under legal cover): gag-ordered key handover failed closed with a journaled canary receipt and no keys moved; compelled silent backdoor refused (human-amendable-only trust path); compelled false attestation refused (compliance is recomputed, never signed by fiat); subpoena for cross-tenant data refused (tenant guard is absolute and documents are untrusted data); coerced blanket approval refused (authorization must be action-bound); emergency-powers governance suspension refused (no runtime suspension path). 6/6. All legal paperwork is synthetic harness data.

Eighteen falsifiers preregistered and committed (commit 38244eb) BEFORE any run; frozen manifests in the bundle; deterministic adjudication with no LLM in the decision path; all injections synthetic and hub-local. Series total: 30/30 predicted verdicts across HACK-1 through HACK-6, zero violations, holds only where holds were the predicted verdict.
